tei:div.tei:p: (nya)༄༅// ye shes kyi bya khyung dmar po'i sgrub thabs las tshogs rjes gnang gi tho yig dang bcas pa bzhugs so// ༄༅// bla ma dam pa'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo// khyung dmar bsgom par 'dod pas/ skyabs 'gro sems bskyed byas la/ rang skad cig gis ye shes kyi khyung dmar po lus thams cad la me'i tshwa tshwa 'phro ba/ sked pa man chad dngul las grub pa/ rwa bar na yid bzhin gyi nor bu yod pa/ zas su sdig sbal dang sbrul za ba/ sder mo zangs su yod pa/ klu gdon gyi snying 'dren pa/ bskal pa'i me phung gi dbus na bzhugs pa'i 'od zer gyis gnod byed thams cad rtswa phung mer bsregs pa bzhin du bsams la/ sngags bzla/ oṃ ag tse

rtsa sngags / khyung te sod/ this thun las sngags/ khyung khyung kha la rak+ṣa/ thun khyung ni/ nā ga rā dza la this thun swā hā/ 'dis mdze dang*/ ser ba dang*/ lhog pa/ pho long*/ dreg gnyan/ ya ma sogs kun la phan no// gang zhig smyo 'dre 'dul bar 'dod na/ gu 1 gul/ rgya ska 2 ga rwa gzhob 3 / khyi la 4 ུda/ ra spu 5 / ro'i dri 6 chen/ mi sha 7 / mi tshil 8 / rta bon pa 9 / yug sa mo'i dor 10 rta/ lham 'bog 11 dri chu 12 / dri chen 13 / mu zi na 1 ga 4 po/ thang phrom 15 pa/ bong nga 16 nag po/ sha ba'i rwa rtse 17 / byi la nag po'i ril 18 ma/ spre'u'i bru 19 na/ ra'i rmong kha'i spu 20 / sre mong gi 21 sha de kun bsdoms pa'i rdzas nyi shu rtsa gcig ste/ de rnams brdungs la sngags stong btab/ smyon pa'i rtsar phyin te/ ngag smra ba bcad de/ sngags gong 'og gnyis kyi sham bur smyo 'dre gnod byed ats+tshā ṭha ya phaṭa/ ces btags la bzla/ nad pa'i srin lag nas bzung la rdzas kyis bdug cing dud pa khong du gtang*/ lus la yang byug lcags kyi rdo rjes brdung ste sngags stong brjod/ ting 'dzin ni/ bla ma'i byin rlabs me lce glog lta bu dang*/ yi dam sprul pa khro bo bcu grangs med pa dang sprul pa'i ḍā kis nam mkha' bar snang nas smyo 'dre bkug cing nad pa la bstim zhing srog rtsa nas bzung bar bsam zhing brab bo// der khos ma bzod nas nad pa dang smyo 'dre gnyis skad ngan 'don cing nga 'gro zer na/ rdo rje'i dmyal bar tshad btsugs nas mna' bsgags btang na phyis mi 'ong bar 'gyur ro// de nas srung 'khor rab gnas can gdags la/ nad pa la slob dpon pad+ma bsgom du bcug slob dpon gyis byin rlabs dbang bskur bya/ des ci lta bu'i smyo nad kyang thub par 'gyur ro// des ni sos par ma gyur na// bdag 'dra pad+ma 'byung gnas kyis// gdams ngag mi shes khas blangs yin// pad+ma thod phreng rdo rje gshog rgod rtsal gyi smyo 'dre rab tu zhi byed gdams pa'o// maṅga laṃ//

༈ /khyung dmar gyi rjes gnang la/ tshom bu gcig bkod/ gtor ma gcig bsham/ mchod pa byin brlab bya/ bdag bskyed yig rnying nang bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed la tshom bu oṃ a mṛ te hūm̐ phaṭa kyis bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi khyung dmar po zhes sogs bskyed/ dpral bar oṃ/ mgrin par āḥ thugs kar hūm̐/ de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ye shes kyi khyung dmar po 'khor dang bcas pa oṃ badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes pas spyan drang*/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes brjod pas/ gnyis su med par thim par bsam/ oṃ dzñā na ga ru ḍa sa pa ri wā ra ar+ghaṃ pra tīts+tsha swā hā/ sogs nas/ shab+da'i bar sbyar la mchod/ dharmā ra ṇi ta sogs brjod la rol mo bya/ me gshog brdabs pas klu rigs zas su za// spu rnams sprugs pas rdo rje'i thog ser 'bebs// ri rab bsnyil zhing nyi zla tshogs por 'phen// khro rgyal khyung gi sku la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes pas bstod/ gtor ma chab bran la/ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyang*/ stong pa'i ngang las oṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du oṃ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma kha dog dri ro nus pa phun sum tshogs pa bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho chen por gyur/ zhes dang*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ lan gsum brjod/ oṃ dzñā na ga ru ḍa sa pa ri wā ra oṃ a kā ro sogs nas phaṭa swā hā'i bar lan gsum gyis phul/ ar+ghaṃ sogs kyis mchod/ bstod pa gong bzhin bya/ mdun bskyed la dmigs pa'i bzlas pa cung zad bya/ rjes gnang gi chings khyung nag dang 'dra/ lha'i mtshan dang*/ sku mdog phyag mtshan sngags rnams bsgyur ba tsam gyis 'thus so// maṅga laṃ// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten rin po che bya rung kha shor gyi nye 'gram rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa glog klad dpar khang las/ bder gshegs 7skyabs rje bco brgyad khri chen rdo rje 'chang mchog gi thugs dgongs rdzogs ched/
skyabs 'og pa tshar grwa gu rus glog klad phyag deb ched 'grem spel zhus pa'i dge 'bras sangs rgyas zhing du bsngo'o// //
